Can reply ≠ sends periodically.
The Agent protocol can reply to ping, but neither the frontend nor this Cloud route schedules one.

Keepalive belongs to one connection.
MCP heartbeats and Cloud ↔ device polling cannot keep the browser’s Agent socket alive.

Model output creates traffic. During quiet generation, this Agent socket has no independent heartbeat.
